Who We Are BioMarin is a global biotechnology company that relentlessly pursues bold science to translate genetic discoveries into new medicines that advance the future of human health.

Since our founding in 1997, we have applied our scientific expertise in understanding the underlying causes of genetic conditions to create transformative medicines, using a number of treatment modalities. Using our unparalleled expertise in genetics and molecular biology, we develop medicines for patients with significant unmet medical need.

We enlist the best of the best – people with the right technical expertise and a relentless drive to solve real problems – and create an environment that empowers our teams to pursue bold, innovative science.

With this distinctive approach to drug discovery, we’ve produced a diverse pipeline of commercial, clinical and preclinical candidates that have well-understood biology and provide an opportunity to be first-to-market or offer a substantial benefit over existing therapeutic options.

About Commercial Our Commercial organization leads our global sales and marketing strategies around the world. Our integrated team continues to solidify BioMarin’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children.

These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating, and have few, if any, treatment options.

BioMarin aims to improve life and health outcomes for people with rare diseases by advocating the use of innovative BioMarin therapeutics, advancing the standard of care and providing personalized support and services globally. BioMarin’s Commercial organization supports our global sales and marketing efforts around the world.

Our global sales force continues to solidify the company’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

The company’s BladderScan portable ultrasound and GlideScope video laryngoscopy & bronchoscopy systems effectively address unmet needs for healthcare providers and meaningfully raise the standard of care for patients.

Verathon , a subsidiary of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, USA and has international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

What is Invisible?

Recorded Demo -
Who are we?
We’re Invisible’s Growth Team. We are an irreplaceable strategic growth partner for the world's fastest growing & most innovative companies, powering their digital workflows so they can focus on building their businesses - not running them.
The Job
Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will be our first sales development representative (SDR). We are looking for a passionate individual eager to play a key role in driving the go-to-market efforts of a fast-growing company that will be the next iconic brand (imagine being the first SDR at Amazon or Google).

The goal of the SDR is to help enable Invisible’s mission to automate repetitive work for every company so people can focus on their real work by developing leads that can be directed to Account Executives for closing.

You will be responsible for developing and executing an outbound outreach program to reach our key target accounts, achieve our monthly sales targets, and play a key role in helping us grow 3x again in 2022.
Who We Want
Sales Development will be an important member of the Sales team. Our ability to achieve our goals comes down, in a large part, to the type and number of clients you will add. We are looking for individuals with the full spectrum of abilities and we are extremely selective. The ideal candidate is a blend of 3 key strengths:
1) You have demonstrated success in achieving quota and running outbound initiatives
2) The right candidate will find a way in to each of our target accounts, having a ‘hunter-mentality’ to find a way into each target and to win
3) You have experience with outbound methodologies beyond just emails and cold calls, you have strong competitive DNA and are always looking for creative ways to prospect
This ‘hunter-mentality’ is key to continuing our high growth trajectory: we grew 3x in 2020, 4x in 2021, and plan to grow rapidly by 3x again in 2022. We are looking for individuals with the full spectrum of abilities and we are extremely selective.

Preferably 1-3 years experience as a sales intern, BDR, or SDR, within an SaaS, RPA, BPO, or high-growth organization
Tech-savvy, preferably with strong domain knowledge of the insurance, financial services, retail-tech, proptech, health-tech or fintech industries
Have a deep understanding of how to leverage and implement a multi-pronged approach (calls, emails, Linkedin, social selling, Sales automation tools and more)
Excellent team-building, sales, customer service, and interpersonal skills
Rockstar sales-hunter skills to thrive in collaborative cross-functional fast-paced environments
Analyze data to identify trends and communicate appropriately to sales management
· Schedule demos for Account Executives
Desire for growth and development in a fast-growth environment

-- Invisible is a world-changing company and the Growth Team is responsible for sourcing, closing, and developing clients until they no longer execute their digital repetitive work themselves
-- Great client relationships are predicated on trust, sincerity & achievement of the customer’s goals
-- Exponential gains from systems > Short term linear work > Systems for system's sake
-- Consistent feedback is key - we are addicted to learning and getting better
-- What one of us knows, all of us should know
Because of these beliefs, we’ve built a team where...
-- Distributed approaches and centralized intelligence merge. Each teammate is constantly innovating and trying something new. Every mistake is prevented by all. Every success is learned by all.
-- Each of us contains the sum of the knowledge, intelligence, and creativity of our entire team.
-- We evolve and mutate constantly like an organism, identifying successful and problematic tactics and incorporating ideas from any source.
US (EDT or PDT) Hours

You will report directly to the Head of Sales. Additional opportunities to earn more equity through promotions and through re-distribution of re-acquired shares via buybacks

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us– our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with a team of people driven to discover more about ourselves and the world around us, Altra just may be the place for you.

It works closely with Field Service Representatives, specialty retail accounts, and cross-functional Altra teams to drive sales and activation plans. Overall, the role is responsible for executing sales strategies, managing account relationships, and growing wholesale business, reporting directly to the Sales Manager, West

Utilize consumer, market share and POS data insights to sustain and grow retail business while proactively addressing issues and opportunities.

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 3+ years of experience and professional achievements.

About Dutchie
Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.
Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.
About This Job
As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers.

To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.
This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

Outbound Prospecting: Build and work target account lists across U.S. dispensaries, using state, license status, and market maturity to prioritize who you reach out to and when.
Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.
Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.
Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.
Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.
Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

1+ years of experience in a sales, BDR/SDR, or outbound prospecting role, preferably within B2B SaaS or tech.
A track record of hitting activity and pipeline-generation targets in a metrics-driven environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to cold call and the ability to write outreach that doesn't sound templated.
Comfort working in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and following a defined process for logging activity and disposition.
A coachable, growth-oriented mindset — you want mentorship from a strong team and a path toward Account Executive or Account Management.
Genuine curiosity about the cannabis retail industry and a willingness to learn the regulatory nuances that shape how dispensaries buy.
Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.
It’s a Bonus if You…
Have prior outbound (not just inbound) sales experience and can speak to how you build and prioritize a target account list.
Have experience with sales engagement/sequencing tools and call intelligence platforms (e.g., Gong).
Have sold into retail, POS, fintech, or another regulated or vertical SaaS market.
Have exposure to or interest in the cannabis industry specifically.

About AirOps
AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.
Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.
Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.
You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities.

Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.
Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.
Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.
Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.
The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.
Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.
Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.
High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.
Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.
A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.
The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.
Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

## **Qu'est-ce qui vous attend?** ##
· **Développement et suivi de la clientèle dans les prestations de base:** identification des besoins de la clientèle et proposition de solutions adaptées en matière de gestion courante, épargne, moyens de paiement, placements et prévoyance de base
· **Développement du portefeuille clients:** acquisition de nouveaux clients, développement et suivi du portefeuille existant, tout en contribuant activement aux actions de prospection du marché
· **Collaboration et travail en équipe:** identification des besoins spécifiques et orientation des clients vers les conseillers spécialisés, en favorisant une collaboration efficace au sein de l'équipe
· **Engagement dans un environnement responsable:** évolution dans une banque coopérative aux valeurs fortes, en contribuant activement à une approche durable et responsable, donnant du sens à l'activité professionnelle
